text: The initiative is characterized by its programmatic operation with continuity across political transitions, ensuring sustained reforms. It is informed by the 2020 joint IMF–World Bank FSAP Update and supported by comprehensive World Bank technical assistance. The three-pronged policy architecture balances safety, inclusion, and sustainability, integrating stability, financial inclusion, and climate/disaster risk finance. Despite substantial overall risk, the operation achieved satisfactory ratings for progress toward the Project Development Objective and implementation progress.
